chunks: And from him, from ʿUthmān, from Ibn Miskān, from Mālik ibn Aʿyan, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever forgets the wiping of his head, then remembers that he did not wipe his head, then if there is moisture in his beard, let him take from it and wipe his head; and if there is no moisture in his beard, then let him leave and repeat the wudu (ablution).

key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification before salat
key_terms.رَأْسِهِ: his head, the part to be wiped in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.مَسْحَ: the act of wiping as part of wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets to wipe his head during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets to wipe his head in wudu (ablution) and only remembers afterward. If moisture remains in the beard, he may use it to perform the wiping; otherwise, he must repeat the wudu (ablution).
